mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and unemployment rate indicate aggressive monetary tightening during labor market weakness, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction term between FEDFUNDS and UNRATE has a positive coefficient in 20-day return regressions with p-value < 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion regimes with RSAFS growth exceeding 2% annually correlate with accelerating consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes (RSAFS growth > 2% annually), 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly growth in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) consistently signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months with PAYEMS growth exceeding 50,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100.0 (index 2017=100) for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal broad-based economic weakness, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term between HOUST and INDPRO has a positive coefficient in 20-day return regressions with p-value < 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising) correlate with higher borrowing costs and reduced economic activity, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising), 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.
